text:
maria: Heads-up — planning a prod push tomorrow 2026-03-21 06:00 UTC. Need clarity on who is allowed to press and any temp claim gaps.

deploy-bot: Deploy bot: window noted. Make sure signer and MFA are ready.

tj: I can press but my JIT claim expires at 05:50 UTC. Will need extension or a temp key.

kevin: @tj can you request extension from infra? Policy prefers short-lived keys rather than long JIT extensions.

janet: I can provision a temp delegated key (svcacct rotate pattern) but need explicit approver and the exact scope.

sre-lead: Prefered flow: primary presser = oncall + one signer. Fallback = eng-release-signer group. MFA required, audit tag mandatory.

maria: Release pinned to v1.9.3-rc4 -> prod v1.9.3. Rollforward decision: if failure before 50% canary => rollback. After 50% => assess, only patch rollback allowed. Canary plan below.

kevin: Adding release notes snippet:
```
chore: pin model to 2.4.1
fix: reduce KV cache backpressure on high concurrency
```

security-bot: Security reminder: delegated keys must be rotated within 24h and KMS audit logs enabled. File an exception ticket for >24h retention.

janet: I can create the temp key with scope: deploy:press, deploy:rollback, audits:write. Who is approver? @maria confirm?

maria: Approver = @sre-lead. Canary thresholds: start 10% for 10 minutes (debug logging), then 50% for 15 minutes. If SLOs stable, proceed to full. Approve temp key for janet. :spiral_calendar:

sre-lead: :thumbsup: Approve temp key for janet. Pair presser with signer @kevin.

oncall: I'll monitor latency, errors, and infra. Ping this thread when canary hits 10% so I can start checks.

tj: Copy. I'll be on standby for pressing and quick rollback if needed.

kevin: Rollback snippet for runbook:
```
# rollback to previous stable
/deploy rollback prod v1.9.2 --reason "canary errors" --audit-tag "rollback-1778888888"
```

maria: I'll open change window in calendar and post final notes to #releases. Also requesting MFA verification and will update the deployer whitelist to [maria, tj, kevin, janet] for the window.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for 2026-03-21T06:00:00Z. Deployer whitelist locked to [maria, tj, kevin, janet] for the window.

kevin: One ask — enable debug logging only on canary subset for 10m to help triage.

sre-lead: Agreed. Start debug for 10 minutes at 10% canary then revert automatically. Document in runbook.

maria: Action items: janet = create temp key + KMS logs; kevin = add rollback snippet to runbook; tj = oncall presser; sre-lead = approve and monitor. I'll post final release note with exact deploy command and checklist.

oncall: I'll be watching. Ping when you hit canary 10%.

kevin: Ready.

tj: Ready.

maria: Thanks everyone — will post final checklist in 1h.
